summary: Preserve route broadcasts and shared-input token addressing in dynamic MoE
compatibility: Applies to native and compressed weights. Deterministic W4A8 M32 execution now reads the correct token activation for each routed pair.
details: A CTA barrier prevents reuse of the shared work-claim slot before every warp has retained its value.
Shared W4A8 payload and scale gathers convert deterministic routed-pair indices back to token indices before computing Int64 global offsets.
Preparation retains the separate deterministic top-k reduction as well as every selected scale decoder before frozen graph replay.
